about: The research ruler for the magnetic Tape core (windsor#219): synthetic oversampled source fields (H, dH at every RK4 stage point) and the research core trajectory on each, with its knee conditioning, for the centre and the eight control corners; and its knee on a grid. Written by scripts/tape-magnetic-fixtures.mjs from the research sources hashed here; never edited by hand. Float64 arrays are little-endian base64.
